name: tft28_ili9341
title: 2.8-inch TFT on an ILI9341, SPI
description: A 240x320 colour display on SPI, eight contacts in a row: the backlight on a line of its own, BLK, and MISO to read the controller back

front.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13, straightened

back.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13, straightened

photo.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13
photo.notes: The silkscreen over the pins: GND VCC CLK MOSI RES DC BLK MISO, GND on a square pad.

silkscreen.source: the module: 2.8'TFT_LCD 240*320 RGB on the front, 2.8'TFT_LCD 240*320 and DRIVER IC:ILI9341 on the back; the size in mm is the 2.8 inches over the 3:4 of 240x320, not measured. Not tried.

start.source: What an ILI9341 does with MADCTL 0 on a panel of 240x320. At which corner of this module the first pixel lies is not tried.

levels.source: No regulator is seen on the board: U2, a SOT-23 next to R5 and R6, looks like the switch of the backlight, so VCC would go to the panel as it is. Not measured.
